# ARWP Agent Skills

Use these portable skills when an AI coding agent should improve, prepare or maintain a website under ARWP.

## Default growth workflow
- arwp-growth-loop — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-growth-loop/SKILL.md

Use it for Search growth, Google Discover/recommendations, generative Search, AI citations, current platform adaptation and ongoing evidence-backed website improvement.

## Reference benchmarking
- arwp-search-maturity — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-search-maturity/SKILL.md

Use it to compare a target site with timestamped independent Search/AI reference cohorts. Repeated features remain observational evidence unless stronger evidence exists; numeric rank requires explicit rank evidence.

## Initial preparation
- arwp-prepare-site — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-prepare-site/SKILL.md

## Adaptive implementation
- arwp-adaptive-upgrade — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-adaptive-upgrade/SKILL.md
- arwp-target-transformation — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-target-transformation/SKILL.md

## Specialists
- arwp-ai-search-content — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-ai-search-content/SKILL.md
- arwp-future-search — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-future-search/SKILL.md
- arwp-dataset-publication — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-dataset-publication/SKILL.md
- arwp-agent-discovery — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-agent-discovery/SKILL.md
- arwp-evidence-ci — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-evidence-ci/SKILL.md

Use arwp-future-search after current crawl/index/canonical/content/identity foundations are healthy. It may implement truthful broader Schema.org semantics and experimental machine graphs even when they are not current ranking requirements, but each mechanism keeps explicit maturity and verification.

## Install
npx skills add dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile

## Rule
Research -> classify current vs observational vs experimental -> benchmark when useful -> implement -> verify -> measure. Do not claim that ARWP, a reference-cohort pattern, semantic-index JSON-LD, llms.txt, Schema.org volume, Agent Skills or another metadata mechanism guarantees ranking, Discover placement, AI citation, recommendations or traffic.
